subheading: Sharpen soft photos, recover detail, and clean up compression with dedicated enhancement workflows in ComfyUI.
extendedDescription:
An image enhancer earns its name when the photo still looks like your photo afterwards, only cleaner. The workflows on this page are restoration-style enhancers rather than filters: they sharpen soft focus, reduce noise and compression artifacts, and rebuild fine detail while keeping the subject, colors, and composition intact. The featured Image Enhancer is built on SeedVR2, a model designed specifically for realistic image restoration.

Different photos fail in different ways, so the page carries specialist workflows alongside the general one. Topaz Image Enhance targets overall clarity and detail recovery. Magnific Skin Enhancer focuses on portraits, refining skin texture without the plastic look that generic sharpening produces. The Nano Banana Pro enhancement workflow leans on a strong image model to reconstruct detail in harder cases where the source is very soft.

Each workflow is an editable ComfyUI graph. You control the enhancement strength instead of accepting one baked-in level, run comparisons side by side, and batch a whole folder when a shoot needs the same treatment. Everything runs on Comfy Cloud in the browser with no install, or locally in ComfyUI, and exports full-resolution results with no watermark.

styles.title: Sharpen soft photos
styles.description: Recover crisp edges from slightly missed focus or camera shake without halos or crunchy artifacts.

styles.title: Portrait skin enhancement
styles.description: Refine skin texture and detail in portraits while keeping the person recognizably themselves.

styles.title: Compression cleanup
styles.description: Remove JPEG blockiness and messaging-app compression from photos that were shared too many times.

styles.title: Low-light denoise
styles.description: Reduce noise from high-ISO shots while preserving the detail the noise was hiding.

styles.title: Detail reconstruction
styles.description: Rebuild fine texture in very soft sources where sharpening alone has nothing left to work with.

howToUse: Pick the workflow that matches the problem: the SeedVR2 enhancer for general quality, Topaz for clarity, Magnific for portraits.
Open it on Comfy Cloud with the Try button, or load it in your local ComfyUI.
Upload the photo you want to enhance.
Adjust the enhancement strength if the workflow exposes it, starting subtle.
Run it and compare the result against the original at full size.
Export the enhanced image at full resolution, or batch the rest of the shoot with the same settings.

faqItems.question: What does an image enhancer actually do?
faqItems.answer: It improves the technical quality of an existing photo: sharpness, noise, compression artifacts, and fine detail, while keeping the content and composition unchanged.

faqItems.question: How is this different from upscaling?
faqItems.answer: Enhancement improves quality at the same resolution; upscaling increases resolution. The AI image upscaler page covers upscaling, and some photos benefit from both in sequence.

faqItems.question: Will it change how people look in my photos?
faqItems.answer: The workflows are restoration-oriented and aim to preserve identity. The portrait enhancer refines skin texture specifically to avoid the artificial look of generic smoothing.

faqItems.question: Which workflow should I start with?
faqItems.answer: Start with the featured SeedVR2 Image Enhancer for general photos. Use Magnific Skin Enhancer for portraits and the Nano Banana Pro workflow for very soft sources.

faqItems.question: Do I need to install anything?
faqItems.answer: No. The Try buttons run each workflow on Comfy Cloud in the browser. Local ComfyUI is supported with the same graphs if you prefer your own GPU.
